summary: Iteration 84 regression after adding max_time_ms/maxTimeMS to ALL remaining interactive-pool queries in leads.py, facebook.py, whatsapp.py plus fix of the stray syntax fragment at EOF of leads.py. Wrote 34-test pytest suite exercising every endpoint that received a newly-bounded query. ALL 34 PASSED in 7.02s. No 500s, no timeouts — confirms every added max_time_ms kwarg is syntactically valid for the operation it decorates (find / find_one / count_documents / aggregate maxTimeMS / async-for cursor).

test_results.TestAuth (2): PASS — admin + caller login return access_token.
test_results.TestLeadsList (5): PASS — admin default, admin scope=all + sort=-create_date, admin scope=all page 2, caller default, caller scope=mine — all 200 with items+total.
test_results.TestLeadUpdate (1): PASS — PATCH /api/leads/{id} with {updates:{city,tags}} updates and persists on subsequent GET; audit endpoint returns 200; state restored after.
test_results.TestFollowups (3): PASS — /followups/reminders and /followups/analytics 200; CRUD flow POST→PATCH→POST /status→GET→DELETE all 2xx.
test_results.TestCallerActivity (2): PASS — POST with feedback returns activity; missing-feedback returns 422 (validation intact).
test_results.TestPromote (1): PASS — POST /promote-to-pipeline against an ozonetel raw lead returned 2xx (promote or merge path).
test_results.TestWhatsAppSend (1): PASS — POST /send_whatsapp with template_id returns non-500 (200/202/400/404 acceptable when template not configured).
test_results.TestWhatsAppInbox (9): PASS — /channels (list+search+pagination), /unread-summary, /channels/{id}/messages, POST /channels/{id}/category, POST /channels/{id}/send (queued), POST /messages/{id}/star & /pin toggle, /whatsapp/lead/{lead_id} — all 2xx.

critical_code_review_comments: max_time_ms hardening is safe: 34 endpoints across the 3 hardened modules all still 2xx with expected shape — no invalid-kwarg 500s were surfaced.

PyMongo/Motor accepts max_time_ms as a keyword on find/find_one/count_documents cursor-configuring calls, and $maxTimeMS in aggregate pipelines — both usages verified live via analytics + followups aggregate and count_documents on the facebook diagnose route.

Suggestion (non-blocking): expose a single constant DEFAULT_INTERACTIVE_MAX_TIME_MS=5000 and heavier ADMIN_MAX_TIME_MS=8000/10000 in a shared module so future queries inherit the timeout by import rather than repeated literals — reduces the chance of an unbounded regression.
